row_unit: one capture, intended pane reference, model, depth stream, requested frame budget and scanline setting

units.accepted_frames: accepted measurement frames; may be smaller than requested_cv

identifiers.scan: non-identifying study capture number; retains manuscript correspondence
identifiers.front_group: pseudonym for visually assigned repeated-front grouping
identifiers.reference_id: pseudonymous intended pane ID unique within capture; never matched by similar dimensions

missing_values: Empty CSV values represent absent numeric results; never zero errors.
numeric_measurement: True if width and height were returned; rejected/absent rows remain in denominator
primary27: Whether capture belongs to fixed primary cohort
timing: Original full ten-frame per-model report times repeated across configurations; deduplicate on scan/model. Cached selected work and aggregation times are not live latency of an independently executed configuration.
